kill.name: Kill
kill.effect: Resolved on the validated tick; cooldown by player count (balance.json); spawns the kill clues and gives the killer Blood.

killerLock.name: Lock door
killerLock.effect: Locks a house door from the outside only; the lock expires. Any door unlocks from the inside.

dragBody.name: Drag body
dragBody.effect: Hold E to drag at reduced speed; dropping it into a body spot hides it; leaves a drag smear.

plantClue.name: Plant Clue
plantClue.effect: Places a footprint trail or a thread with the traits you choose. Inspect marks it Forged.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.effect: Breaks a locked door; the door stays broken.

inherit.name: Inherit
inherit.effect: When the last Killer dies or is ejected the Knife passes to you with a longer kill cooldown; your Hunger clock starts in the round you inherit.

inspect.name: Inspect
inspect.effect: Reveals a clue's hidden attribute, exposes forgeries and marks it Verified. A dropped Magnifier lets anyone Inspect, slower.

dustCompare.name: Dust / Compare
dustCompare.effect: Dust lifts a print (limited charges); Compare any two prints: Match / No match. Never gives a name.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.effect: Not self. The target survives the next kill attempt within the window; both are knocked back, the target's screen blacks out and gets the attacker's height as Claimed; witnesses get height + scarf as Claimed; the attacker still gains Blood.

autopsy.name: Autopsy
autopsy.effect: Posts time of death (within the error) and cause (knife / wolf / poison / shot) as Verified.

lockUnlock.name: Lock / Unlock
lockUnlock.effect: Locks or unlocks any house door instantly. Locks keep people out, never in.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.effect: At each meeting, privately lists for each living player the last house they entered this cycle (house only, no time).

silentHide.name: Silent hide
silentHide.effect: Hide instantly and without noise; crawlspaces fit only you and adults cannot Check them.

witness.name: Witness
witness.effect: With line of sight to a kill within range, "The Child saw it" posts the killer's height + scarf as Verified at the next meeting.

slingshot.name: Slingshot
slingshot.effect: A small hit from range that Stuns (balance.json body.damage.slingshot); at zero health the target is knocked out.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.effect: Your chores fill the village bar; each one writes a Claimed alibi entry (time + scene).

chalk.name: Chalk
chalk.effect: Draws a floor mark visible to everyone.

actShifty.name: Act Shifty
actShifty.effect: Emits fake noise rings where you stand.

fakeBlood.name: Fake Blood
fakeBlood.effect: Shows Blood on your sprite in the world (meetings show portraits).

arrest.name: Arrest
arrest.effect: Cuffs the target and drags them to the square; the next meeting opens with them as a Case Closed suspect.

snare.name: Snare
snare.effect: Holds whoever steps in and logs the name.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.effect: Takes one item from a player.

skeletonKey.name: Skeleton Key
skeletonKey.effect: Opens any locked door and leaves a print on it.

wash.name: Wash
wash.effect: Washes Blood off at the well or a basin and leaves a Wet Bucket clue.

heal.name: Medkit
heal.effect: Restores body.healHp health and stops Bleeding; self or a seat in reach.

light.name: Light
light.effect: Toggles a carried light; wolves flee it, but off is stealthier.

collect.name: Collect
collect.effect: Stand on a clue and hold E: it enters the Notebook with trait, scene and time.

report.name: Report body
report.effect: Starts a meeting; everyone moves to the square; the body stays.

bell.name: Emergency Bell
bell.effect: Rings the bell on the square to call a meeting; pulls per match come from the role.

hide.name: Hide
hide.effect: Enter a free hiding spot; you see a slit view and keep one action, Burst Out.

check.name: Check
check.effect: Opens a spot; checking an occupied spot writes a Verified entry for the hider naming you and the time.

burstOut.name: Burst Out
burstOut.effect: Leave a spot instantly, stunning whoever is Checking it.

sneak.name: Sneak
sneak.effect: Shift: silent footsteps at reduced speed.

impersonate.name: Impersonate
impersonate.effect: Your character shows a living seat's name, look, scarf and hat glyph at your own height for balance.json impersonate.durationS. The face changes only unseen: at once if no other living seat is in your scene, otherwise at your next door; cancelled at no cost if it has not changed within impersonate.applyWindowS or when it is used again or day breaks first. A Knife strike drops it in place with a puff; a meeting or your death ends it; using it again, the time running out or daybreak drop it the next time you are alone in your scene or pass a door. The cooldown runs from the drop. Not self.

confession.name: Hear Confession
confession.effect: Your Notebook gets the seat's faction (Village, Cabal or Neutral) as Verified. Not self.

keepWatch.name: Keep Watch
keepWatch.effect: The seat survives the first Knife strike before the night ends; the strike fails as on a Bandaged target and your Notebook records it. Not self, and not the seat you watched the night before (balance.json nightPowers.watchRepeatAllowed).

remedy.name: Remedy
remedy.effect: The seat survives the first Knife strike before the next meeting opens; your Notebook records it when it holds. It does not stop Nightshade or a shot.

poison.name: Nightshade
poison.effect: The seat dies when the night ends, a meeting opens or the Final Night hunt ends, wherever it stands; its body lies there with no trait clue. Not self.

lastShot.name: Last Shot
lastShot.effect: When you are killed, poisoned or ejected you may pick one living seat within the aim time, before you learn any role; it dies too. Accepted only while you aim. Not self.

strike.name: Strike
strike.effect: Fists, every card, every world phase: a small hit that costs stamina (balance.json body.strikeStamina, body.damage.strike). At zero health the target is knocked out, never killed. Public: the swing plays for everyone in sight; no clue unless blood is drawn.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.effect: The Remedy by day, whoever holds it (the Herbalist's, kept): cures Poisoned on a seat in reach.

eat.name: Eat
eat.effect: Eats a food item: cures Famished and Weakened; a Wake Loaf also restores stamina to full.

eatStew.name: Eat Stew
eatStew.effect: Eats the Stew: cures Famished and Weakened.

eatHerbBread.name: Eat Herb Bread
eatHerbBread.effect: Eats the Herb Bread: cures Famished and Weakened, and Poisoned lasts half as long until the next dawn.

skin.name: Skin
skin.effect: Skins the nearest fallen creature in reach that has not been skinned, for the hide and game its row names (mobs.json skin). Wears the knife one use. Public to nobody: no noise, no clue, no animation beyond the swing of any use.
